200.description: Transaction list (page-based). meta.total is the exact filter-aware row count for pagination; meta.hasMore indicates a next page.

items.description: Transaction with its ledger entries (key fields shown; additional fields may be present). Shared shape for GET /transactions (list) and GET /transactions/{id} (detail) — the only difference is coaJournal.lines, which is populated only on the detail endpoint.

transactionPlatformId.description: Exchange/on-chain transaction hash or platform-assigned id.

type.description: Canonical type derived from the label; null when the label has none.

isMissingTransaction.description: Set by the balance stage when the running balance went negative (missing purchase history).

allOf.description: Per-transaction COA tag + ERP-sync summary (enterprise only).

tagStatus.description: tagged = every ledger carries the COA side(s) its transaction type requires (both for deposit/withdrawal/payment, one for trade/transfer legs, always both for a fee leg); partial = some work is done and something is still missing; untagged = nothing is done. Progress is judged on non-fee legs, falling back to fee legs on a fee-only transaction.

allOf.title: CoaStatus

coaStatus.description: Enterprise only — COA tag + ERP-sync summary. Absent for retail workspaces.

allOf.description: A journal is a 1-1 extension of a transaction, keyed by transactionId (no separate id). Shared shape for GET /coa/journals and the coaJournal field on the transactions endpoints — workspaceId/timestampOfTransaction/createdAt/updatedAt are only populated by GET /coa/journals.

baseCurrency.description: The journal's reporting currency (default USD). Only on GET /coa/journals.

timestampOfTransaction.description: epoch ms — the parent transaction timestamp (joined)

syncedToERP.description: Whether these amounts are in the ERP.

syncedVia.description:
HOW it got there. `journal` — pushed on its own, and it holds its own ERP id. `rollup` — posted as part of a period close, which holds the ERP id; this journal's own id columns are null and that is correct. `null` — not in the ERP.

Derived from `syncedToERP` + `rollupId`. Without it a close-posted row reads as 'synced' while holding no ERP id anywhere, which looks like a bug.

rollupId.description: The period close this journal belongs to, or null. Written when the close is CREATED, so it can be set while `syncedToERP` is still false — the close exists but has not been pushed. A journal carrying this is excluded from new closes, and an explicit push of it is rejected with COVERED_BY_ROLLUP.

rollup.description: The close named by `rollupId`, hydrated — carrying the CLOSE's ERP ids, not this journal's. When `syncedVia` is `rollup` these are the only ids that resolve to anything in the ERP, so render from here rather than fetching the close separately. Null when the journal belongs to no close. Populated only by the transactions endpoints, not GET /coa/journals.

journalDate.description: epoch ms — the date the close posts under

isDirty.description: The journals under this close have changed since it was pushed, so the ERP copy is stale.

lines.description: Present on GET /coa/journals when includeLines=true, and unconditionally on GET /transactions/{id} (enterprise). Absent from GET /coa/journals otherwise and from the GET /transactions list endpoint (header only).

baseCurrency.description: The line's reporting currency (default USD). Only on GET /coa/journals.

allOf.description: Curated coa_accounts details attached to a journal line for display.
allOf.title: CoaLineAccount

coaAccount.description: The account this line resolves to (name/class/etc). Populated on GET /transactions/{id} and on GET /coa/journals when includeLines=true; null when the code no longer resolves to an account.

allOf.title: CoaJournal

coaJournal.description: Enterprise only — COA journal header (null when untagged). Absent for retail. Includes `lines` only on GET /transactions/{id}; the list endpoint returns the header only.

explorerLinkSrc.description: For detected transfers: which side to build the blockchain explorer link from.

explorerLink.description: Blockchain explorer URL for this transaction’s on-chain hash. Null when the tx has no known chain explorer (e.g. a CEX trade) or no hash.

isSplitted.description: True when recovered from a split; excluded from transfer re-detection.

isMergedTrx.description: True only when the user merged this transaction by hand via POST /transactions/merge. Auto-detected Transfers / Bridge Transfers / Swaps leave it false — check `trxsMerged` to tell whether a row was formed from other transactions, regardless of who merged them.

trxsMerged.description: Snapshots (without id) of the deposit + withdrawal consumed to form this transfer/swap; used to restore the originals on split.

netValue.description: Fiat value of the transaction = sum of `quantity × unit price` over ONE side of its value-bearing legs — the incoming side when present, otherwise the outgoing side. Both sides are never summed (that would double-count a trade), and fee legs are excluded. `fiatValue` is null when ANY incoming/outgoing leg has no usable price, so the total is never a partial sum or a misleading 0; a transaction with no incoming/outgoing legs at all is 0. Merged transactions carry the value inherited from their members (summed for same-side merges, taken from one side for deposit+withdrawal merges) rather than a recompute over the merged legs.

fiatValue.description: null when any incoming/outgoing leg is unpriced. Denominated in `currency` below, which is taken from the transaction's own legs on reprice paths and falls back to the workspace base currency.

incomingAssets.description: Incoming ledger legs (persisted shape, not the create-request shape).

items.description: A ledger row as returned inside a transaction response (incomingAssets / outgoingAssets / fee). This is the persisted ledger shape (with the resolved asset joined in) — distinct from the IncomingAsset/OutgoingAsset/FeeAsset request schemas used to CREATE a transaction. Numeric columns are serialized as strings.

walletId.description: Owning integration account id (authoritative source for the leg).

syncId.description: Sync run that produced this leg.

assetId.description: Resolved asset id; null while asset resolution is pending.

allOf.description: A raw, un-matched asset descriptor used inside transaction asset legs.

type.description: Asset class. Used to drive matching and tax treatment.

chainId.description: Chain identifier the asset lives on.

contractAddress.description: Token contract address (for on-chain tokens / NFTs).

allOf.title: RawAsset

assetRaw.description: Raw parser asset descriptor, kept for deferred resolution.

asset.description: Resolved asset (joined from assets); null when assetId is unresolved.

allOf.description: A point-in-time price for an asset leg, in the given base currency.

price.description: Unit price in baseCurrency — never a line total. Multiply by the leg quantity to get its fiat value (the API already does this for the leg `value` and for `netValue`).

baseCurrency.description: ISO currency code the price is denominated in.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch (ms) the price was observed.

source.description: Pricing source identifier. `custom` marks a workspace price override; `derived` marks a price inferred from the priced side of a two-sided trade by value conservation (counter-value ÷ quantity) rather than quoted by a provider.

allOf.title: PriceModel

price.description: null when the leg has no price.

value.description: Fiat value of this leg = quantity × price, in baseCurrency. Derived at read time; null when the leg has no price.

allOf.description: The wallet / exchange account an asset leg moves from, to, or pays a fee from.

publicAddress.description: Public wallet address for this account.

walletId.description: Internal integration account id this leg is attributed to.

isContract.description: True if the address is a smart contract rather than an EOA.

allOf.title: AccountType

allOf.description: The wallet / exchange account an asset leg moves from, to, or pays a fee from.

publicAddress.description: Public wallet address for this account.

walletId.description: Internal integration account id this leg is attributed to.

isContract.description: True if the address is a smart contract rather than an EOA.

allOf.title: AccountType

isMissingPurchase.description: Set by the balance recompute: this outgoing/fee leg drove its (wallet, asset) running balance to a new negative low (missing purchase history). False until the (wallet, asset) pair of this leg is recomputed; legs of Spam/Ignore transactions keep their last value.

isEdited.description: True when a user manually edited this leg.

debitCoaCode.description: Enterprise only — GL code posted to on the debit side.

creditCoaCode.description: Enterprise only — GL code posted to on the credit side.

isDebitCoaEdited.description: True when the debit code was manually set (COA re-run skips it).

isCreditCoaEdited.description: True when the credit code was manually set (COA re-run skips it).

coaRuleAppliedAt.description: When a rule last (re)assigned this leg. Null on manual/default-map codes.
